name: Dark Fantasy Choco Fills
ingredients_raw: CHOCO CRÈME (38.0%) (SUGAR, REFINED PALMOLEIN, REFINED PALM OIL, COCOA SOLIDS, EMULSIFIER [LECITHIN (FROM SOYABEAN) NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (CHOCOLATE) ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (VANILLA)}, MAIDA (REFINED WHEAT FLOUR), HYDROGENATED VEGETABLE OIL, SUGAR, INVERT SYRUP LIQUID GLUCOSE, RAISING AGENTS [503(ii), 500(ii) 450(i)], COCOA SOLIDS (0.7%), BUTTER, MILK SOLIDS, IODIZED SALT, NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES MILK CHOCOLATE), COLOURS (150c, 150d), EMULSIFIERS [LECITHIN (FROM SOYABEAN), MONO AND DIGLYCERIDES OF FATTY ACIDS (FROM PALM OIL)], ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (MILK, VANILLA). CONTAINS WHEAT, MILK, SOY. MAY CONTAIN NUT, SULPHITE
